evidence.detail: Reviewed DeveloperToolsPlugin obtains rs/s/c/g from the injector, builds a navigation button titled exactly 'Developer Tools' with devtools_icon.png, binds rs/s/c/g as that button's PluginPanel, and registers the button with ClientUI.
rs/s/c/g directly extends the reviewed plugin-panel base rs/ui/m and contains only the Developer Tools navigation/card UI state.
The panel binds the reviewed DeveloperToolsSidebarPanel to an exact tab labeled 'Recolor models' with palette.png.
The second panel card is created from the DeveloperToolsPlugin configuration component and bound to an exact tab labeled 'Interfaces' with interface.png.

Its activation/deactivation hooks delegate only to the currently selected child PluginPanel, while tab switches use one CardLayout and the two exact Developer Tools cards; no unrelated feature is hosted.

candidates.note: DeveloperToolsPluginPanel is fixed by the exact 'Developer Tools' navigation registration, PluginPanel base and exclusive Recolor models/Interfaces card surface. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: Reviewed InterfaceDeveloperToolsConfig exposes the exact option key showTypes / title 'Display widget types' as Set<rs/s/c/h>, defaulting to Set.of(rs/s/c/h.values()).
The enum preserves seven exact values: SCROLL, BTN, TXT, RECT, SPRT, DRPDWN and INV, each carrying the client widget-type id used by the interface system plus a presentation color.
Reviewed DevToolsWidgetOverlay maps each live widget's exact type integer through rs/s/c/h's static id-to-enum map and filters it through the configured Display widget types Set.
Reviewed DevToolsWidgetDisplay stores rs/s/c/h directly in its field represented by the surviving self-identifying toString component 'type=…'.

candidates.note: DevToolsWidgetType is fixed by the exact 'Display widget types' config binding, surviving widget-type abbreviations and direct DevToolsWidgetOverlay/WidgetDisplay use. Confidence is 0.999.
